d:
This is the new Aston Martin Valkyrie LM, a customer version of the Valkyrie that’s raced at Le Mans for the past two years. Its unsilenced V12 is limited to just under 700bhp, but it weighs only 1030kg and has colossal amounts of downforce. It might be the best sounding car of 2026, and somehow, an even more extreme version of the already-extreme Aston Martin Valkyrie.
